title: Cooler fall nights mean it is time for the extra blanket
dek: The last day of September is a good time to pull out the heavier blanket and make the bedroom ready for fall.
body: If you are awake at this hour, you may have noticed the air feels a little different now. Late September nights have started to cool down, and the thin summer sheet I have been using no longer feels like enough by the early morning.

I have a small ritual for this change. I take the heavier blanket out of the closet, give it a wash so it smells fresh, and fold it at the foot of the bed. That way I can pull it up in the middle of the night without having to get up and look for it.

I also like to check the little things. I make sure the window closes easily, I put a pair of socks near the bed, and I keep a glass of water on the nightstand because the air feels drier when the heater starts running.

The seasons change slowly where I live, so these small signals matter. A warmer blanket, a cup of something hot in the evening, and an earlier sunset all remind me that the year is turning. Today is also National Hot Mulled Cider Day, which seems like perfect timing.
If you are chilly right now, grab a second blanket instead of adjusting the thermostat. Your body will settle faster, and you can make the full switch to fall bedding this weekend.
